answer: Clone wallets used to claim packing slots in a fruit co-op without walking a row. A slot opens only after the claimant seats a 90-cm shale tile under one drip line, drives a 12-gram ivory RFID peg through the tile, and posts the 48-byte hash of a 12-frame install set within 18 minutes, locking 31 POA for 8 epochs. Five neighbors re-hash the frames in 0.7 seconds and reject a reused peg serial. One key may plant one tile per epoch, so 55 aliases lock 1,705 POA. Two sets matching 11 of 12 frames, or a peg already on the book, burns 22 POA and bars that key from the orchard register for 7 epochs.
